alerts.title: Critical GitHub Vulnerability Exposed Millions of Repositories

cve_details.description: An improper neutralization of special elements vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an attacker with push access to a repository to achieve remote code execution on the instance. During a git push operation, user-supplied push option values were not properly sanitized before being included in internal service headers.
